body: The problem is that this appears to be hard coded into testcontainers. It retries 10 times per second for 30 seconds. Even if I filter out the logs then Quarkus will appear to hang for 30s, which is probably worse.
but since docker isn't running, shouldn't it fail fast and produce a single meaningful error? What's the reason to keep trying?
It's hard coded into testcontainers as far as I can see. I agree that it does not make sense.

ok. Sorry @rsvoboda looks like we won't be able to fix this in short time, but let's keep it open for a little longer in hope to figure out something - perhaps with the help of the testcontainers team.
